selection: Representative published constraints, including a JWST study; not a complete catalogue or an independent joint likelihood.
value_source: Numbers transcribed from primary abstracts and text, not digitized figures.

McGreer et al. (2015).locator: Abstract; 0.04+0.05 at z=5.6, 0.06+0.05 at z=5.9. Plot 1-sigma upper bounds, not detections.

Davies et al. (2018).locator: Abstract; posterior medians and 68% credible intervals, marginalized over quasar lifetimes 1e3--1e8 yr. Two distinct quasars; do not add alternative analyses of the same objects as independent points.

Mason et al. (2026).locator: Section 5.2 and Fig. 10: bins 5.5--8.0 and 8.0--10.6, mean redshifts 6.5 and 9.3. Adopt intervals including conservative sightline-variance addition of sigma=0.1. Include GNz11; do not double-count the alternative >0.70 bound without GNz11.

metadata_verification: ADS API queried using all four arXiv identifiers on 2026-09-13.
redshift_interpretation: z_min/z_max give the published JWST bin extent, not a redshift measurement error. For other entries no width is specified here; equal bounds do not imply an infinitely narrow physical sample.
interpretation: Except dark-pixel upper limits, these are observationally inferred xHI posteriors conditional on radiative-transfer and source assumptions. Wide-bin JWST constraints must not be treated as precision pointwise data. No joint chi-square from these summary intervals.
